value.rationale: The geometrically canonical transpose quotient of the minimal balanced chessboard complex carrying Z/3 torsion provides a nontrivial three-primary cancellation phenomenon: the torsion class changes sign and disappears from the quotient even though the rational homology leaves exactly 28 three-dimensional generators. This determines a natural genuine local homotopy type, beyond routine Betti counts and an arbitrary slice.
